scientific_integrity: Proof gives the precise zero-difference convention, an exact second-moment identity, the adaptive splitting recurrence, and a uniform threshold induction. Finite code is corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Proves a uniform three-level upper bound on the deficiency from the counting ceiling, not exact dimension or any improvement in ordinary VC dimension. Characteristic two, restricted query/center domains, and other multiplicative subgroups are outside scope. Historical priority and external scientific validation remain open.
title: Near-information-theoretic online shattering of quadratic-residue translates
